competition.title: Smoke Competition
competition.summary: Build minimal counter and dice applications to validate the competition submission, run, and leaderboard pipeline.
competition.notice: Two compact task packs are available for fast end-to-end pipeline checks.

tasks.title: ARC Counter Smoke Test

tasks.title: ARC Dice Smoke Test
tasks.summary: Use ARC to build an extremely small dice application for verifying the metered competition submission and leaderboard pipeline.

flow: Upload an agent snapshot or select a built-in one.
Compile the large requirement into smaller runnable modules.
Run the GitHub-style and spreadsheet-style tasks in order.
Inspect evidence and refine the system until the output is stable.
rules: Treat the requirement document as the source of truth.
Keep changes small enough to verify each step.
Use the task artifacts to explain what your agent changed.
